Morning team — putting together a compact runbook for next Thursday's virtual onsite with Maya Ortiz (SWE, candidate track). Because we have three tight panels and risk of last-minute interviewer conflicts, I propose a "Hot-swap Cascade" pattern: primary panel -> immediate warm standby -> staggered fallback lanes. Key asks below: 1) Confirm you're owning the following panels and whether you can be the 2nd-stage hot-swap for a neighboring panel. 2) Review the debrief rubric and confirm your scoring anchor. 3) If you're unavailable for any of the slots, please flag an alternative in the panel_rotation_matrix.csv attachment.

Proposed schedule (Pacific):
- 09:30–10:15 — System Design (Panel A) — Owner: laura_bennett
- 10:30–11:00 — Deep Dive / Live-coding (Panel B) — Owner: marcus_lin
- 11:15–12:00 — Behavioral / Culture (Panel C) — Owner: irene_choi

Hot-swap rules (short):
- If an owner drops within 24h -> warm-standby (person listed as 'standby' steps in)
- If an owner drops within 1h -> cascade: move Panel B into Panel A's slot, Panel C moves into B, and we enable a short 20-min buffer for candidate reboot.
- Each owner should have their eval rubric open (see debrief_rubric_v2.xlsx) and pre-assign scribe for feedback capture.

Attachments: MayaOrtiz_Resume.pdf, debrief_rubric_v2.xlsx, panel_rotation_matrix.csv

Next steps: please reply with a one-line confirm or alternate by EOD today. I will publish the calendar with the final lanes at 16:30 and share the candidate-facing logistics.

Thanks — Jasmine
